description: Copy and synchronize files locally or over a remote transport.

categories.name: Transfer
categories.description: Control which files are copied and how directory trees are traversed.

options.detail: Equivalent to -rlptgoD. Preserves common file attributes and recurses into directories. ACLs, extended attributes, and hard links require separate options.

options.summary: Skip files newer at the destination
Skip destination files that already exist

categories.name: Preview
categories.description: Inspect proposed changes before running a transfer.

options.summary: Show a trial run without changing files
options.detail: Combine with --itemize-changes to inspect planned updates. Selecting this option only inserts text into the shell buffer.

categories.name: Filtering
categories.description: Include and exclude paths using rsync pattern syntax.

options.detail: The cursor remains after the equals sign. Enter and quote the pattern as required by Bash.

options.summary: Read exclusion patterns from a file

options.detail: The command is entered manually as an option value. It is not invoked by the help browser.

categories.name: Attributes
categories.description: Preserve additional file metadata when supported by the filesystems.

options.summary: Transfer numeric user and group identifiers

categories.name: Deletion
categories.description: Deletion options affect destination data when the command is subsequently executed.

options.detail: Review the source and destination carefully. A dry run can show proposed deletions before execution.

options.summary: Compare checksums instead of modification time and size
Use file size to decide whether an update is needed

categories.name: Recovery
categories.description: Retain partial transfers and backup copies.

options.summary: Keep backups of replaced destination files
Store backups in a separate directory
